notes.title: Announcement of temporary removal of the game 'Xianxia Zhenchen 2'
notes.notes:
Hello to the few players, thank you for not choosing to refund despite the fact that the game has never been enjoyable.
Due to design philosophy issues, the playability of "Xianxia Zhenchen 2" is poor, and after trying various methods, it still cannot be solved. The development team believes that the game cannot solve this problem with minimal modifications and needs to overturn the underlying design - that is, completely redo the game.
So we will temporarily remove the game from the Steam store, and once the development of "Xianxia Dicheng Lu" comes to an end, we will resume the development of the game. During this period, players who have already purchased can still open the game normally, and when the game is relisted for sale, they do not need to pay again and can directly play the remade game

notes.title: Data progress bar display
notes.notes: In the system settings, you can choose to display the character's data on the progress bar above the character's head

notes.title: An attempt to modify an operation
notes.notes:
Now clicking on the villain will bring up some command menus, which can forcibly control the villain regardless of their mood and state.

In order to guide players to click on the character, the mouse style was even modified

I don't know if such changes are good or bad, but in short, the game is deviating from its original design direction

notes.title: Friendship System Menu
notes.notes: Now players can see the list of friendship systems in the menu

notes.title: Fixed a bug that required manual termination when making friends
notes.notes: Npc does not have an end time for social interaction and requires manual intervention to proceed with the next step. This has been fixed, but it is still not perfect enough. We will continue to follow up on this code in the future

notes.title: Reconstructed the action rules of NPC
notes.notes:
Mainly aimed at fixing the frequent entry and exit of visiting monks into the secret realm after the construction of the inn. After the fix, a test was conducted and an unknown bug appeared. However, the bug was traced for a whole day and no recurrence was found. If any player finds that visiting cultivators have problems practicing at the inn, please contact the production team. You can add a group of 958747116 or go to Baidu Tieba Xianxia Cleansing Dust Book to reflect.

In addition, currently, monks may get stuck while making friends, and this bug is still being investigated. It is expected to be updated and fixed in tomorrow's version.

After fixing the above two bugs, the production team will make revisions to address the fatal design issue of slow game pace. The current consideration is to compress the timeline of 4000 years of in-game time to 40 years of in-game time. This will result in significant changes in numerical values and storyline, and once the changes are completed, the playability of the game will greatly improve.

I understand that the current state of the game is disappointing, but the production team is working hard. Thank you to friends who have not yet refunded, and I will not disappoint your support.

notes.title: Achievement and Guidance System Launch
notes.notes: Because I don't know how to test the achievement system on this machine, there may be bugs in the online version, but if any bugs are found, they will be fixed as soon as possible.

notes.title: Achievement system and novice guidance will be launched in the near future
notes.notes: Hello everyone, I haven't updated for several days because I'm working on the achievement system. Many players say they don't understand when they enter the game and there's no beginner guidance. It's because I want to integrate the beginner guide of this game into the achievement system like Terraria. So in the past few days, I have been working overtime to catch up with the achievement system, and it is expected that it will be launched tonight or tomorrow (or possibly the day after tomorrow).

notes.title: The Atlas system has been launched
notes.notes:
Add a new picture guide system, with the main function key added on the right side of the entrance, and the default shortcut key H.

This function is first to make it easier for players to know which channel to obtain the materials they want, and second to prepare for accessing Steam's achievement system. At present, most players' problems such as unclear gameplay and wanting beginner guidance can also be solved immediately, as the author intends to emulate Terraria and use the achievement system to guide players to become familiar with the game.

notes.title: The function of purchasing items from visiting monks has been launched
notes.notes:
After the player builds the inn, visiting friars can also enter the secret realm to explore. If some important materials are obtained by the visiting friar and the player does not want to hire the friar (after the player hires the visiting friar, the items on the visiting friar will also belong to the sect, of course, the cost in this case will be relatively expensive), they can choose to only purchase the friar's items.

notes.title: Malignant bug emergency repair
notes.notes:
Dear players, we are very sorry that due to the hasty launch, there are still many shortcomings in the game. Although I have been fixing bugs for the past few days, they are all some UI issues that do not affect the normal operation of the game as long as the game is restarted.

But today's bug is really too big. If a new formula has been successfully developed using the rear hall in the game, it will cause confusion in the archived data.

This bug has been fixed now, but players who have previously had data errors may need to start a new game again. We are very sorry.

Thank you for your support of the game. Although there are still some unfinished features in the game, and even because the game pace is too slow, it can be said that it is not a fun game. However, with my efforts, I will make this game more fun. I hope everyone will continue to pay attention to it

notes.title: Add windowing function and fix Lingtian bug
notes.notes:
Added three windowed resolutions: 1600x900, 1280x720, and 1024x768. Additionally, there are two options for running in the background (active) for each resolution. This feature allows players to choose the display mode of the game and decide whether the game will continue to run normally when the game window is not active.

The UI of Lingtian originally had the function of deleting the current crop by clicking on the name of Lingzhi. However, due to concerns about whether players may accidentally operate everything but did not do it, there was a bug in the remaining function interface, which has been fixed. In the future, when a better deletion method is determined, the function of deleting Lingzhi will be added
